tasks.short: Plan, evaluate and revise law curricula and teaching materials

steps.what: Read the existing curriculum, actual student feedback, assessment findings and relevant legal-source changes
inputs: existing course and curriculum materials
actual student feedback and assessment findings
teacher-selected authoritative legal sources
outputs: teacher-checked evidence of content and teaching issues

steps.what: Evaluate the course and decide the learning outcomes, content changes and instructional methods
inputs: teacher-checked evidence of content and teaching issues
actual programme requirements and teaching constraints
outputs: teacher's revision decisions and learning-outcome brief

steps.what: Revise the actual curriculum, cases, readings and teaching materials and check their legal accuracy and instructional fit
inputs: teacher's revision decisions and learning-outcome brief
existing course and curriculum materials
teacher-selected authoritative legal sources

loop.purpose: Draft bounded revisions to existing teaching materials
loop.input: existing material, teacher's revision brief and supplied legal-source excerpts
loop.output: suggested material revisions linked to supplied source passages
loop.check: teacher checks every legal proposition, citation, example and learning-outcome alignment
loop.stop: missing supporting passage, conflicting law or uncertain jurisdiction returns that section to manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: templates handle headings but cannot express the requested changes to case discussion and explanation

steps.what: Save the completed checked revision in the existing course workspace
inputs: complete checked revised course-material version

tasks.design: Configure native version and source views across {LMS}, {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the institution's legal-source library. A bounded drafting aid uses the teacher's revision brief and supplied sources; the teacher evaluates the curriculum and checks the finished materials before saving them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material revisions require repeated cross-reference between prior teaching content and source evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Document comparison and source-bounded drafting can assist an actual revision without deciding the curriculum.
tasks.still_hard: Legal accuracy, jurisdiction, teaching aims and student misconceptions require expert judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Choose what students should learn and how cases should develop legal reasoning.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for source licences and teaching-material permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native version views and source-bounded draft assistance can support course-material revision, with expert checking of legal claims.

assumptions: Shares are provisional decomposition of the actual revision task, not measured baselines or prompt time shares.
OTHER means authorised legal-source libraries. Teacher-supplied sources are read in s1; selecting the revision brief is counted in s2.
No student-level data is uploaded; aggregate existing feedback suffices. Missing legal support stops drafting.
Gross provisional saving 14.75 minus 2 hours of source-package and drafting-rule upkeep gives 12.75 net; saving remains fully retained.
Existing equivalent comparison/drafting support removes any corresponding additional saving. No publication or curriculum-board decision is automated.
unknowns: Current revision effort and permitted source reuse
research_questions: Can real revisions be drafted from supplied sources with less total writing and checking time?

already_counted.description: Inspect sources, decide revisions and correct suggested material

incremental.description: Maintain permitted source packaging and test drafting instructions on changed material

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 12.75%; legal checking may consume all drafting gains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain law teaching materials and supplies

steps.what: Identify the actual course's subject coverage, edition needs, student access constraints and available budget
inputs: actual course requirements
existing budget and student access arrangements

steps.what: Look up actual textbook editions, content, availability, prices and licence terms in current authorised catalogues
inputs: teacher's material selection requirements
actual library and supplier catalogue records
outputs: teacher-checked available material options and terms

steps.what: Evaluate the actual materials and select them, completing and checking the existing acquisition request with item, edition, quantity and terms
inputs: teacher-checked available material options and terms
teacher's material selection requirements
outputs: complete checked acquisition request for selected materials

steps.what: Submit the completed acquisition request to the institutional procurement route
inputs: complete checked acquisition request for selected materials

tasks.design: Use the native catalogue and approved-item views in {OTHER} and {PROCUREMENT} to reduce repeated navigation when locating real editions and terms. The teacher evaluates the texts and completes the acquisition request before submitting it through the existing procurement route.
tasks.previous_blocker: Edition and access information may require repeated catalogue navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing catalogue filters and item links can bring the relevant records together.
tasks.still_hard: A current edition can still be a poor teaching choice or inaccessible to students.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the textbook's pedagogy, legal coverage and student suitability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: catalogue filters and approved-item views can reduce navigation while teachers retain selection and procurement follows institutional controls.

assumptions: Provisional shares are unmeasured. Selection and its ordinary acquisition request are counted together, without inventing a long order-writing baseline.
OTHER means library and supplier catalogues. Their existing item records supply the inputs; missing prices or terms require manual inquiry.
This scenario uses an internal requisition, not direct supplier ordering; procurement's later approval and purchase are not claimed as teacher savings.
Gross provisional saving 3 minus 0.5 hour of catalogue-link upkeep gives 2.5 net. The final submit remains fully retained.
Equivalent existing catalogue navigation gives no new saving.
unknowns: Actual acquisition route and current catalogue views
research_questions: Are real selections slowed by repeated catalogue navigation rather than reading and evaluation?

already_counted.description: Review available options and evaluate/select the materials

incremental.description: Keep institution catalogue links and filter settings current

approvals.approved_version: complete checked acquisition request for selected materials

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2.5%; requires actual repeated navigation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hold scheduled office hours and help law students

steps.what: Look up course instructions, the student's submitted work or the relevant source when a question during office hours requires it
inputs: student's actual question and submitted work
existing course instructions and authorised legal sources
outputs: teacher-read information relevant to the student's question

steps.what: Be available at the scheduled time, discuss the student's difficulty and provide individual explanation and assistance
inputs: student's actual question and response
teacher-read information relevant to the student's question
outputs: actual student discussion and individual assistance

tasks.design: Keep individual office-hour assistance with the teacher. The occasional lookup is separated and uses existing {LMS} course links and {OTHER} legal-library search; no additional retrieval change is established by this task alone.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is scheduled availability and responsive teaching rather than repetitive preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing course links already support the occasional lookup; no additional mechanism is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Students need different explanations and may disclose problems that were not in the initial question.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise misunderstanding and adapt the discussion sensitively.

ambition.what: No increase in office-hour capacity claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scheduled office hours require teacher availability and responsive discussion; native course links can already support lookups.

assumptions: The 8/92 split is an illustrative unmeasured allocation, not term-level preparation amortised into every office hour.
OTHER means authorised legal-library search. Student questions and submitted work are the actual inputs.
Actual lookup is split from conversation and fully retained. The statement establishes no separate written report or message; none is manufactured.
No change is proposed, so gross and net saving are zero and there is no added maintenance work.
unknowns: Actual frequency and friction of office-hour lookups
research_questions: Do observed office hours reveal repeated lookup or written follow-up work that needs its own design?

incremental.description: No new system or process proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Availability, discussion and existing native lookup remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise students on study choices and careers

steps.what: Read the relevant actual programme rules, curriculum options and career information for the student's situation
inputs: student's stated academic and career situation
current institutional curriculum rules and actual career information
outputs: teacher-checked options and constraints relevant to this student

steps.what: Discuss the student's aims and constraints, explain the options and give individual academic or career advice
inputs: teacher-checked options and constraints relevant to this student
student's actual preferences and questions
outputs: actual individual advice and discussion of choices

tasks.design: Configure a native bookmark/filter view of the authoritative programme catalogue and career resources in {OTHER}, alongside course information in {LMS}. The teacher reads the relevant source and advises the student through discussion; the view makes no recommendation or student eligibility decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant programme and career information can sit in separate institutional pages.
tasks.enabler_now: A maintained native resource view can shorten repeated navigation.
tasks.still_hard: A student's aims and circumstances rarely map to a single best option.
tasks.human_edge: Explain trade-offs and respect the student's own choice.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native resource views can reduce programme-information navigation while individual academic and career advice stays with the teacher.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not observed advising baselines. OTHER means institutional programme catalogues and career resources.
Existing institutional publishers maintain the source information; no invented structured student profile is required.
No report or send is established by this statement. Actual retrieval is split from the conversation; written follow-up, if observed, needs separate costing.
Gross provisional saving 1.5 minus 0.5 hour of resource-link upkeep gives 1 net. Existing equivalent views give no new saving.
unknowns: Current retrieval effort and existing resource views
research_questions: Do real advising cases involve repeated navigation that this view would remove?

already_counted.description: Read and assess the retrieved programme/career sources

incremental.description: Check resource links and catalogue versions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1%; most advising remains conversation and individual judgment.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Maintain authoritative course and advising resources
Evaluate changes through actual student learning needs
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated source navigation and bounded material drafting while preserving expert legal teaching and individual student advice.
